title: How to Build a Custom Business Dashboard Without Code
summary: Build a real-time business dashboard with KPIs, charts, and data from multiple sources in hours. No developer needed. Complete guide with prompts for Blink.
body_markdown: Any data stored in your Blink database, data from connected APIs (Stripe, HubSpot, Google Analytics, Shopify), and data imported via CSV. The dashboard can display metrics, trends, tables, and anything you can describe in plain English. If the data exists somewhere accessible, Blink can pull it and display it.
